Managing Partner

Makarand Datar

Mak

Connecting business growth, global markets and practical execution.

Mak brings more than thirty years of experience in entrepreneurship, management consulting and business transformation. His work connects three questions: where a business can grow, what needs to change, and how to turn the opportunity into action.

Emailmak@setuhashi.com

LinkedIn profile ↗ (opens in a new tab)

Experience he brings

Mak began his entrepreneurial career helping manufacturers enter overseas markets, developing market strategies, customer relationships, distribution channels and cross-border sourcing arrangements.

He subsequently held consulting leadership roles at PwC, Infosys Consulting and Accenture. His work has spanned market development, customer experience, sales and service innovation, operating models and technology-enabled transformation, from focused advisory assignments to complex global programmes.

He has developed business cases, shaped commercial arrangements and led multidisciplinary teams through implementation, keeping the commercial opportunity connected to the people, capabilities and decisions needed to make it work.

A personal connection across borders

Born and raised in India, Mak studied and built much of his career in the United States. He also lived and worked in Japan for a year, developing an enduring affection for its people and culture.

Work, education and travel across more than eighty countries have shaped his curiosity about how people build relationships and conduct business. He maintains strong personal ties to India and brings a global perspective to his commitment to the Japan–India relationship.

His commitment to SetuHashi

At SetuHashi, Mak brings together business strategy, opportunity development and the coordination of complex undertakings. Working alongside Raju and Shyam, he is committed to helping Japanese and Indian businesses combine their strengths, develop worthwhile opportunities and carry them forward.

Selected experience

Examples from Mak’s work before SetuHashi, and from individual advisory work with Shyam. They are not work carried out by SetuHashi.

  • Supporting a Japanese institution’s global trading transformation

    Connecting requirements across markets for a Japanese institution’s global transformation.

  • Opening markets for industrial manufacturers

    Turning market strategy into the practical work of entering new countries for manufacturers.

  • Helping Indian manufacturers reach US customers

    Turning Indian manufacturers’ export ambitions into US customer relationships.

  • Shaping a ten-market growth strategy

    Aligning services, solutions and geographic expansion around a long-term growth ambition.

    Shyam Sundar Pani and Makarand Datar · individual advisory experience

    Exploring how an established business could create new value from its existing assets.

  • Transforming sales and service at scale

    Connecting customer experience, commercial performance and delivery in a large transformation.
